levels.name: Smoke / Reproducible Harness
levels.goal: Prove that Quest Arena, Agent Zoo, RAG trace and durable run recording work end to end.
levels.promotionGate: At least one reproducible completed run and no broken trace or archive path.

levels.name: Single-Model Professional Baseline
levels.goal: Measure individual models on the same professional quest before adding collaboration effects.
levels.promotionGate: At least two real model candidates have repeated runs on the same quest and strict review exists.

levels.name: Critic Pair
levels.goal: Determine whether Draft → Critic → Revision improves professional quality enough to justify extra calls.
levels.promotionGate: Critic pair shows a reviewed benefit on target cases without hiding reviewer objections or violating hard constraints.

levels.name: Diversity + Synthesis
levels.goal: Test whether independent model diversity plus synthesis beats a single model and critic relay.
levels.promotionGate: Parallel synthesis preserves meaningful disagreement and produces a reviewed quality gain on representative cases.

levels.name: Role-Specialized Pipeline
levels.goal: Use different models for Research, Specialist, Reviewer and Synthesis roles with Zoo RAG and explicit authority boundaries.
levels.promotionGate: Role-specialized pipeline is better or materially safer than simpler compositions on the target professional family.

levels.name: Bounded Production Candidate
levels.goal: Promote only a bounded, repeatedly tested model composition with regression, cost/latency evidence, rollback and independent review.
levels.promotionGate: Bounded production candidate passes representative quests and adversarial cases with independent review, regression evidence and rollback path.
